driver_note: All scenario driver values are analyst estimates, not guidance; loan/fee/deposit/wholesale growth use nominal GDP proxy; investment securities grow by fractional deposit growth; Q4 runrate uses actual 9M/3 times stated factors; future blended interest uses average earning pool, shared 364d rates and calibrated rates with partial beta; impairment on average NET loans, gross and allowance unavailable at Sep26 (FY24/25 audited values now recovered), no NPL estimate invented; operating cost growth CPI+spread; property and other assets, nonbank liabilities grow with deposit growth.
